close_reason: Delivered in PR #289 (audited 2026-09-06: Index.id_allocator/1 derived at rollback, cutover and cold load; stacked on #276, no CI run)
description:
Both of Olivine's index rewind points carry the LIVE `IdAllocator` across while installing an OLDER page map, so `free_ids` can name pages that are alive again in the index being installed.

- `IndexManager.rollback_to/2` (index_manager.ex:520-536) rewinds `versions` and re-derives `n_keys`, but leaves `id_allocator` untouched.
- The compaction cutover (server.ex:493) carries `t.index_manager.id_allocator` forward onto the compacted index.

A `clear_range` above the rewind point empties or merges pages and recycles their ids (`index_update.ex:227`, `index_update.ex:377` via `IdAllocator.recycle_id/recycle_ids`). Rewinding below that point brings those pages back to life while the allocator still lists their ids as free. The next split (`index.ex:556` `IdAllocator.allocate_ids`) can hand out a live page's id and `Map.put` straight over it — silent key loss. The replayed suffix also recycles the same ids a second time, so `free_ids` can carry duplicates.

Revival is unaffected: `Index.load_from` recomputes `free_ids` from the loaded page map (index.ex:428, 448-454). That is the shape of the fix — derive the allocator from the index being installed rather than carrying the live one — and it applies at both sites.

`rollback_to/2` is the live one (the recovery path). The cutover is not driven from `lib/` today. bedrock-3v1 newly exposed the cutover to this by compacting the durable page map instead of the live one; before that the cutover installed the live map and the allocator agreed with it.

Found by the cold audit on bedrock-3v1 (note N2).

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/289 — Index.id_allocator/1 derives the allocator from the page map being installed; rollback_to/2, the compaction cutover and recover_from_database all use it. Both sites have failing-without-the-fix repros. Stacked on #276.

title: [BUG] Olivine index rewinds leave the id_allocator ahead of the page map
